NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A Nature villager borrows a Science villager's method to save the coral: admit it, or keep it quiet.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), of the Nature school, has always said that measuring things is cold and unfeeling. But to save the dying coral, (subject.he/she) has secretly started counting the fish every morning, exactly the way (friend), of the Science school, does. (friend) has noticed. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) admits it, embarrassed. (friend) is delighted, and shows (subject.him/her) a better way to count. Together they find that the coral is recovering in the sheltered spots. (subject) says it was the care. (friend) says it was the counting. They count and care together.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) denies everything. (friend) says nothing, and leaves a carved counting stick at (subject)'s door. (subject) uses it every morning and never mentions it. The coral recovers a little.
